title: Deletion does not create one global revocation clock
subtitle: Each authority has its own removal, expiry, connection and recovery contract.
note: A control-plane cleanup result is not proof that every retained copy or already-issued credential can no longer act.

lines: OIDC bearer / browser session / VM action role
Apply the selected service's validation policy
Existing sessions and token lifetimes need evidence
Enrollment / allowed SPIFFE peer / SVID lifetime
Guest entry cleanup and optional agent eviction
Previously issued credentials need relying-service checks
Hard backend fence / export generation / CHAP rotation
A missing Secret does not close a target session
Prove old writer exclusion before replacement
Backup / old source / UEFI and TPM material
Protect copies and assign destruction authority
Live VM deletion does not erase retained artifacts
